# PokeMCP

> Competitive Pokémon data and team building: monthly meta reports for Pokémon Champions and VGC, per-Pokémon usage trends, an AI team builder, and a free REST/MCP API over Smogon usage statistics.

## Meta Reports

- [Meta reports index](https://www.pokemcp.com/reports): monthly written meta reports with usage tables, month-over-month trends, and analysis grounded in Smogon ladder data
- [Pokémon Champions meta report (latest)](https://www.pokemcp.com/reports/champions): the current Champions VGC regulation — usage stats, risers/fallers, regulation changeover analysis

## Tools

- [Team builder](https://www.pokemcp.com/builder): AI-assisted competitive team building with format validation, type coverage, and threat analysis
- [Documentation](https://docs.pokemcp.com): MCP server and REST API docs
- [REST API reference](https://docs.pokemcp.com/api-reference/): free JSON API — usage stats, movesets, teammates, counters, team validation (POST https://api.pokemcp.com/api/tools)

## Data

- Usage statistics are weighted Pokémon Showdown ladder data published monthly by Smogon (smogon.com/stats), refreshed on the 5th of each month
- Supported formats include Pokémon Champions (current regulation), VGC, and Smogon singles tiers
